description: One catch up across your Canvas courses: announcements posted in the last few days, assignments graded in that window and discussions that still have unread replies. Pass since_days to change the window, 7 by default, or course_id as the Canvas course ID or as the course name to check one course. Pass limit and page to step through long lists, 20 items per section by default. Example: "What's new in Canvas since last week?"

course_id.description: Optional, check one Canvas course only.

limit.description: Optional, how many items to show per list. Defaults to 20.

page.description: Optional, which page of items to show, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

since_days.description: How many days back to look for new announcements and newly graded work. Defaults to 7.

name: get_whats_new
title: What's new
